procedure: EA-NEGONT-02 v0.9 §3.4 D/R/O (working; not frozen). Admission by reading: D, a claim on GDPval with the entity named; R, a relation the archive states between GDPval and an archive object; O, an archive category applied to GDPval or to a class the field and the census source for it (configs/openai-gdpval.json, classes 1–5 with their bases). A bare mention, a list of tools or keywords, a citation-list entry or a reference line is not a claim. No archive text names GDPval or its arXiv number (D 0, R 0). The string pass returns an O-class candidate only where a sentence also carries a term of the archive's category vocabulary; beyond it, every archive paragraph matching a class pattern was read at its match (class 1, benchmarks: 38 matches in 17 deposits; class 2, commissions: 92 in 20; class 3, review and redo: 7 in 2; class 4, labor producing AI evaluation: 68 in 33; class 5, model graders: 5 in 3), and the admitted deposits read at the sections named in each claim's locus. The hop (136 candidates in 135 deposits, one citation hop forward and back from the 14 deposits admitted or grouped at the first pass) was screened by script for the class terms and each hit sentence read; two were admitted.
